audit_rule: Report only missing critical field, inconsistent definition, broken dependency, ambiguous unit/coordinate system/acceptance condition, missing provenance requirement, or broken machine-readable gate. Do not rewrite non-blocking items.

findings.type: missing critical field / broken machine-readable traceability
findings.description: Parameter/interface/model/test/evidence IDs are referenced but no canonical registries define their required fields, status, provenance, units, or validation state. orphan_rules therefore cannot be mechanically enforced.
findings.impact: ORPHAN DETECTION AND TRACEABILITY CANNOT BE EXECUTED RELIABLY.

findings.description: current_snapshot sets BLOCKER-V4-EVIDENCE-INTEGRITY as priority-1 while authoritative state declares EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY=PASS.
findings.impact: NEXT ACTION ENGINE can select a blocker that the authority has already closed, violating fail-closed decision consistency.
findings.disposition: MANUS MUST BASE NEXT-ACTION ON AUTHORITATIVE GATE STATE; EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY BLOCKER MUST NOT BE ACTIVE WHEN GATE IS PASS

findings.description: required_inputs are descriptive strings, not machine-readable parameter records with source/unit/provenance/status/evidence-hash fields.
findings.impact: physical input closure cannot be automatically evaluated.

findings.description: time/coordinate/channel/sampling/filtering steps have method=null while marked DEFINED; no deterministic preprocessing method can be executed from the contract alone.
findings.impact: V7 is not truly executable-ready without method bindings.
findings.disposition: REQUIRES EXPLICIT METHOD BINDING BEFORE CORRELATION RUN

findings.description: sampling_rate and measurement_range are declared as fields but their unit/dimensional schema is not enforced by the sensor record definition.
findings.impact: sensor configuration can be syntactically complete but dimensionally ambiguous.

findings.description: signals reserve coordinate_system/reference_frame/sign_convention but leave all three null; this is acceptable as input-required state, but the contract does not define a closed enumeration or transform record schema.
findings.impact: automatic prevention of coordinate/sign mismatch is incomplete.
findings.disposition: REQUIRES EXPLICIT FRAME/TRANSFORM RECORD BEFORE KINEMATIC EXECUTION

findings.description: energy terms require source/equation fields but there is no explicit evidence hash/provenance parent linkage per computed term.
findings.impact: energy ledger cannot be fully auditable at term level.
findings.disposition: BIND EACH TERM TO INPUT/EVIDENCE HASHES AND DERIVATION ID

findings.description: GATE_R4_2_AUTHORIZATION requires explicit authorization AND all prerequisites, but the prerequisite semantics do not explicitly encode the stated condition that MECHANICAL_FAILURE_CONFIRMED and ROOT_CAUSE_CONFIRMED must both be true before authorization.
findings.impact: gate expression is underspecified relative to the master command.
findings.disposition: PETER MUST RETAIN FINAL AUTHORIZATION; gate schema must include explicit failure/root-cause predicates

non_findings: No evidence of fabricated measurements/results was found in the inspected JSON package.
Baseline integrity report correctly states independent hashing was not performed.
No R4.2 artifact was found in the package.
